proposed_highlights: Choose one service at $179: ceramic coating (1-day service), chrome delete window trim (1–3 hours), or headlight restoration pair (45–90 minutes)
Ceramic coating includes exterior wash, decontamination, prep, and professional application — rated for up to 5-year hydrophobic gloss protection
Chrome delete blackout wrap applied to exterior window trim for a sleek, modern de-chromed appearance
Headlight restoration removes oxidation and haze from both headlights for improved clarity and nighttime visibility

Since audit shows 'NO original/retail price displayed anywhere' (value_comm: 4/10, content gap #1) and zero competitor data was collected, customers currently have no baseline to assess whether $179 represents genuine savings. Without this context, the 28% off claim lacks credibility. If merchant cannot provide defensible retail prices, reposition around convenience and quality rather than discount percentage.
executive_summary: This deal scores 4.8/10 overall, dragged down by two critical failures: trust (3/10 — only 1 review and 1 purchase for auto services requiring skill validation) and value communication (4/10 — no original price shown, so customers can't assess the 28% savings claim). The top fixes: (1) display retail prices for each service option so buyers can calculate actual savings, (2) add merchant credentials/certifications to offset weak social proof, and (3) specify ceramic coating brand and warranty details. These changes could lift conversion 20–30% by removing the two biggest purchase blockers: "Can I trust this shop?" and "Is this actually a good deal?"
